method: automated: web search + Claude compile + page verification (scripts/research_stunting_districts.py)
headline: Haveri flags poverty and malnutrition concerns with 29.9% under-five stunting, ranking low on youth opportunity statewide.
summary: Haveri is flagged for poverty by the Karnataka Human Development Report 2022, alongside nine other districts. Under-five stunting stands at 29.9%, close to the national average of 32.4%. The district ranks 28 of 31 in Karnataka for youth opportunity with a score of 44.4 out of 100. Women's anaemia is 50.9%, slightly better than the national 57.0%. Acute severe malnutrition is listed among conditions treated at the District Hospital Haveri under the Ayushman Bharat scheme.

reasons.detail: Haveri is flagged for poverty by the Karnataka Human Development Report 2022, ranking among ten districts with high deprivation levels.

District Hospital Haveri treats acute severe malnutrition under Ayushman Bharat, indicating local burden.

headlines.title: Poverty, malnutrition Karnataka’s shame
headlines.takeaway: Haveri flagged for poverty and malnutrition by Karnataka Human Development Report 2022.

modelFactorWhy.factor: Mothers who took iron-folic acid for 180+ days in pregnancy
modelFactorWhy.why: Women's anaemia in Haveri is documented at 50.9%, slightly better than the national 57.0% but still substantial. No direct evidence on iron-folic acid supplementation compliance is provided.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Adequate iron-folic acid intake during pregnancy prevents maternal anaemia, which reduces low birth weight and subsequent stunting risk.

proof.claim: In Haveri, 50.9% of women are anaemic, against 57.0% nationally.

modelFactorWhy.why: While anganwadis provide pre-school services and enrolment in classes 9-12 equals 67% of that age population, no specific data on 3-6 year old school-going rates in Haveri was found.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Pre-school attendance at anganwadis provides structured nutrition supplementation, growth monitoring, and developmental stimulation, reducing stunting.

modelFactorWhy.factor: Household members covered by health insurance
modelFactorWhy.why: District Hospital Haveri is empanelled under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, indicating local access to health insurance schemes. No data on coverage rates among households was provided.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Health insurance coverage increases healthcare utilization for maternal and child health services, improving nutrition and growth outcomes.

proof.claim: District Hospital Haveri empanelled under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY scheme.
